jobs.description:

jobs.title: Infirmier-ère praticien-ne spécialisé-e (IPS)
jobs.description:
Afin de développer un projet pilote conjoint entre la Direction des soins et le Service de chirurgie orthopédique et traumatologie, l’HFR Fribourg – Hôpital cantonal recherche un/une :

• Exercer une pratique infirmière avancée auprès de patients relevant de la chirurgie orthopédique, de la traumatologie et de l’orthogériatrie, dans le cadre légal, conventionnel et institutionnel défini

• Assurer une prise en charge transversale des patients hospitalisés et ambulatoires, en alternant entre les unités d’hospitalisation et les consultations selon les besoins du service et des différentes équipes

• Réaliser des évaluations cliniques, assurer le suivi de l’évolution des patients et prescrire ou adapter des examens et traitements selon les protocoles médico-soignants établis

• Participer aux admissions électives préopératoires, au suivi postopératoire, aux visites, à la préparation des sorties et à la coordination du parcours de soins

• Assurer en consultation le suivi postopératoire et le suivi ambulatoire de situations orthopédiques définies, notamment l’évaluation clinique, les soins de plaies, les examens de contrôle et l’adaptation protocolisée de la rééducation

• Coordonner les différents professionnels impliqués, informer et accompagner les patients et leurs proches et contribuer à la continuité des soins entre l’hôpital, les médecins traitants, la réadaptation et les soins à domicile

• Collaborer étroitement avec le(s) médecin(s) partenaire(s) et l’équipe médicale ; solliciter une validation ou une reprise médicale lorsque la situation dépasse votre champ de compétences ou nécessite une expertise ou une décision médicale

• Participer au développement et à l’actualisation des protocoles, à l’amélioration de la qualité et de la sécurité des soins ainsi qu’au suivi des indicateurs cliniques du projet pilote

• Contribuer à la formation des équipes ainsi qu’aux activités de recherche et de développement clinique

• Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bachelor of Science en soins infirmiers ou d’un titre jugé équivalent reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse

• Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master of Science en Sciences infirmières, orientation infirmier-ère praticien-ne spécialisé-e (MSc IPS)

• Vous disposez d’une expérience clinique infirmière d’au minimum 4 ans, idéalement complétée par une expérience ou une expertise reconnue en chirurgie, orthopédie, traumatologie ou dans un domaine clinique apparenté

• Vous disposez de solides compétences en évaluation clinique, raisonnement clinique, coordination des soins et collaboration interprofessionnelle

• Vous appréciez l’autonomie professionnelle tout en travaillant en partenariat étroit avec les équipes médicales et soignantes

• Vous êtes motivé-e à participer à la construction d’un nouveau modèle de pratique avancée, à l’élaboration de protocoles et à l’évaluation d’un projet pilote innovant

• Vous maîtrisez le français à un niveau avancé ; des connaissances d’allemand et d’anglais constituent un atout

descriptionByLocale.it:
Al fine di sviluppare un progetto pilota congiunto tra il Dipartimento della Salute e il Servizio Chirurgico e Traumatologia Ortopedica, l'ospedale cantonale HFR Fribourg cerca uno/uno:

• Esercizio avanzato di allattamento con pazienti in chirurgia ortopedica, trauma e ortopedia, all'interno del quadro giuridico, convenzionale e istituzionale definito

• Cura trasversale degli ospedali e degli ambulatori, alternando tra unità ospedaliere e consultazioni in base alle esigenze del servizio e alle diverse squadre

• Condurre valutazioni cliniche, monitorare la progressione del paziente e prescrivere o adattare esami e trattamenti secondo i protocolli di assistenza medica stabiliti

• Partecipare a preoperative ammissioni elettive, follow-up post-operativo, visite, preparazione all'uscita e coordinamento del percorso di assistenza

• Consultare il follow-up post-operativo e il follow-up ambulatoriale di situazioni ortopediche definite, compresa la valutazione clinica, la cura delle ferite, gli esami di controllo e l'adattamento del protocollo di riabilitazione

• Coordinare i vari professionisti coinvolti, informare e accompagnare i pazienti e i loro parenti e contribuire alla continuità di cura tra l'ospedale, curando medici, riabilitazione e cura della casa

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il medico e il team medico; richiedere la convalida medica o il rientro quando la situazione supera la vostra competenza o richiede competenze mediche o decisione

• Partecipa allo sviluppo e all'aggiornamento dei protocolli, migliorando la qualità e la sicurezza della cura e monitorando gli indicatori clinici del progetto pilota

• Contribuire alle attività di formazione, ricerca e sviluppo clinico

• Hai un Bachelor of Science in Infermieristica o una qualifica equivalente riconosciuta dalla Croce Rossa svizzera

• Hai un Master of Science in Infermieristica, Specialty Practitioner Infermieristica Orientamento (MSc IPS)

• Hai un'esperienza di cura clinica di almeno 4 anni, idealmente completata da un'esperienza riconosciuta o esperienza in chirurgia, ortopedia, traumatologia o aree cliniche correlate

• Hai una forte esperienza nella valutazione clinica, nel ragionamento clinico, nel coordinamento della cura e nella collaborazione interprofessionale

• Ti piace l'autonomia professionale mentre lavori in stretta collaborazione con team medici e infermieri

• Sei motivato a partecipare alla costruzione di un nuovo modello di pratica avanzata, allo sviluppo di protocolli e alla valutazione di un progetto pilota innovativo

• Lei padroneggia il francese a livello avanzato; la conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese è un bene
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to develop a joint pilot project between the Health Department and the Orthopaedic Surgical and Traumatology Service, the HFR Fribourg – Cantonal Hospital is looking for one/one:

• Exercise advanced nursing practice with patients in orthopaedic surgery, trauma and orthogeriatry, within the defined legal, conventional and institutional framework

• Transversal care of inpatients and outpatients, alternating between hospital units and consultations according to the needs of the service and the different teams

• Conduct clinical assessments, monitor patient progression and prescribe or adapt examinations and treatments according to established medical-care protocols

• Participate in pre-operative elective admissions, post-operative follow-up, visits, exit preparation and co-ordination of the care path

• Consult with post-operative follow-up and outpatient follow-up of defined orthopaedic situations, including clinical assessment, wound care, control examinations and protocol adaptation of rehabilitation

• Coordinate the various professionals involved, inform and accompany patients and their relatives and contribute to the continuity of care between the hospital, treating doctors, rehabilitation and home care

• Work closely with the physician(s) and medical team; request medical validation or re-entry when the situation exceeds your competence or requires medical expertise or decision

• Participate in developing and updating protocols, improving the quality and safety of care and monitoring clinical indicators of the pilot project

• Contribute to team formation, research and clinical development activities

• You have a Bachelor of Science in Nursing or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Swiss Red Cross

• You have a Master of Science in Nursing, Specialty Practitioner Nursing Orientation (MSc IPS)

• You have a clinical nursing experience of at least 4 years, ideally complemented by a recognized experience or expertise in surgery, orthopaedics, traumatology or related clinical areas

• You have strong expertise in clinical evaluation, clinical reasoning, care coordination and interprofessional collaboration

• You enjoy professional autonomy while working in close partnership with medical and nursing teams

• You are motivated to participate in building a new model of advanced practice, developing protocols and evaluating an innovative pilot project

• You master French at an advanced level; knowledge of German and English is an asset
descriptionByLocale.de:
Um ein gemeinsames Pilotprojekt zwischen dem Gesundheitsamt und dem Orthopädischen Chirurgie- und Traumatologischen Dienst zu entwickeln, sucht das HFR-Krankenhaus Freiburg nach einem/einem:

• Fortgeschrittene Pflegepraxis mit Patienten in orthopädischer Chirurgie, Trauma und Orthogeriatrie innerhalb des definierten rechtlichen, konventionellen und institutionellen Rahmens

• Transversale Betreuung von stationären und ambulanten Patienten, abwechselnd zwischen Krankenhauseinheiten und Konsultationen je nach Bedarf des Dienstes und der verschiedenen Teams

• Führen Sie klinische Bewertungen durch, überwachen Sie die Progression des Patienten und verschreiben oder passen Sie Untersuchungen und Behandlungen gemäß den festgelegten medizinischen Versorgungsprotokollen an.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an präoperativen Wahlpflichteinweisungen, postoperativen Follow-up, Besuchen, Exit-Vorbereitung und Koordination des Pflegepfades

• Konsultieren Sie die postoperative Nachsorge und ambulante Nachsorge definierter orthopädischer Situationen, einschließlich klinischer Beurteilung, Wundversorgung, Kontrolluntersuchungen und Protokollanpassung der Rehabilitation

• Koordinieren Sie die verschiedenen beteiligten Fachkräfte, informieren und begleiten Sie Patienten und ihre Angehörigen und tragen Sie zur Kontinuität der Versorgung zwischen Krankenhaus, behandelnden Ärzten, Rehabilitation und häuslicher Pflege bei

• Eng mit dem (den) Arzt(en) und dem medizinischen Team zusammenarbeiten; medizinische Validierung oder Wiedereinreise anfordern, wenn die Situation Ihre Kompetenz übersteigt oder medizinische Expertise oder Entscheidung erfordert

• Teilnahme an der Entwicklung und Aktualisierung von Protokollen, Verbesserung der Qualität und Sicherheit der Versorgung und Überwachung klinischer Indikatoren des Pilotprojekts

• Beitrag zur Teambildung, Forschung und klinischen Entwicklung

• Sie haben einen Bachelor of Science in Pflege oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation, die vom Schweizerischen Roten Kreuz anerkannt ist

• Sie haben einen Master of Science in Nursing, Specialty Practitioner Nursing Orientation (MSc IPS)

• Sie haben eine klinische Krankenpflegeerfahrung von mindestens 4 Jahren, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine anerkannte Erfahrung oder Expertise in Chirurgie, Orthopädie, Traumatologie oder verwandten klinischen Bereichen

• Sie verfügen über fundiertes Fachwissen in den Bereichen klinische Bewertung, klinisches Denken, Pflegekoordination und interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit

• Sie genießen professionelle Autonomie, während Sie in enger Partnerschaft mit medizinischen und Pflegeteams arbeiten

• Sie sind motiviert, am Aufbau eines neuen Modells fortgeschrittener Praxis, der Entwicklung von Protokollen und der Bewertung eines innovativen Pilotprojekts teilzunehmen

• Sie beherrschen Französisch auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau; Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind ein Gewinn

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Infectiology Unit is recognized by ISFM as a Category B post-graduate training institution in infectiousology. Located in the Department of Medicine and Specialties, it operates mainly in HFR Fribourg – Cantonal Hospital, with complex patients (isolation units for onco-haematological treatments, intensive care) and provides a telephone consultation for the three peripheral sites of the hospital. It proposes an ambulatory consultation (HIV, Hepatitis, general infectious disease) for the Fribourgeois population. Infectiology devotes part of its activities to the supervision of the Infection Prevention and Control Unit.
The infectiology unit of the Fribourg hospital is looking for a:

• You ensure on a daytime basis the requests for consultations from the various hospital and outpatient specialties, including general infectiology, septic orthopaedics, surgical infections and immunosuppressed patients.

• Under the supervision of the executive doctors, you ensure the infectious management and follow-up of the patients entrusted to you throughout the institution.

• You are participating in the microbiology laboratory's daily report.

• You participate in post-graduate training.

• You participate in the supervision of assistants in internal medicine turns

You want to move to a degree as an infectious specialist and have completed some or all of your training in internal medicine. We offer you the possibility to join the infection unit for a maximum of 18 months.
Requirements:

• Federal diploma of doctor or diploma recognized equivalent by the Medical Professions Commission (MEBEKO)

• Training in internal medicine including at least 2 years of experience in hospital.

• Wants to get the title of specialist in Infectious Disease.

• Prior experience in clinical infection is an asset.

• Meaning of cooperation in a team and in multidisciplinary, commitment and availability.

• Mastery of the French language, and very good capacity for written and oral expression.

jobs.description:
Le service de pédiatrie de l’HFR recherche un-e infirmier-ère-chef-fe d’unité de soins (ICUS) pour rejoindre une équipe dynamique et engagée. Dans cette fonction clé, vous assurez le leadership et la gestion de l’équipe soignante, garantissez la qualité et la sécurité des soins et contribuez activement au développement du service. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement interprofessionnel stimulant, où l’accompagnement des équipes, l’innovation et l’amélioration continue occupent une place centrale.

• Diriger, fédérer et accompagner les collaborateurs en favorisant un environnement de travail bienveillant, motivant et propice au développement professionnel.

• Garantir la qualité, la sécurité et la continuité des soins pédiatriques, en plaçant l'enfant et sa famille au centre des préoccupations.

• Participer à la politique générale et à l'organisation de l'HFR, en incarnant les valeurs institutionnelles.

• Contribuer, en collaboration avec le chef de service, au processus budgétaire annuel et à une gestion efficiente des ressources.

• Promouvoir le développement des compétences et organiser la formation continue du personnel en collaboration avec le ou la clinicien-ne du service.

• Expérience en gestion d'équipe constituant un atout.

• Maîtrise de la langue française et bonnes connaissances de la langue allemande.

• Leadership fédérateur, capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à accompagner le changement.

• Excellentes qualités relationnelles, sens de la communication, de l'écoute et de la négociation.

• Sens développé de l'organisation, des priorités et des responsabilités.

• Capacité à travailler en réseau et à favoriser la collaboration interprofessionnelle.

• Personnalité proactive, dynamique, créative et flexible, faisant preuve de rigueur et d'autonomie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'HFR Paediatric Service sta cercando un Head Nurse for Care Unit (ICUS) per unire un team dinamico e impegnato. In questa funzione chiave, si garantisce la leadership e la gestione del team di assistenza, garantire la qualità e la sicurezza della cura e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo del servizio. • Leader, federazione e supporto ai dipendenti, promuovendo un ambiente di lavoro attento, motivante e solidale per lo sviluppo professionale.

• Assicurare la qualità, la sicurezza e la continuità della cura pediatrica, ponendo il bambino e la sua famiglia al centro della preoccupazione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la professione medica e i vari partner interdisciplinari, tra cui emergenze pedonali e neonatologia.

• Piombo di progetti di miglioramento e sviluppo, cambiamenti di sostegno e contribuire a obiettivi di servizio e di reparto.

• Promuovere la collaborazione interprofessionale e garantire una comunicazione trasparente e costruttiva con i team, la professione medica e la gerarchia.

• Partecipazione alla politica generale e all'organizzazione dell'HFR, che comprende valori istituzionali.

• Contribuisci, in collaborazione con il Responsabile del Servizio, al processo di bilancio annuale e alla gestione efficiente delle risorse.

• Promuovere lo sviluppo delle competenze e organizzare la formazione continua del personale in collaborazione con il medico.

• Diploma in allattamento riconosciuto dalla Croce Rossa svizzera.

• Diploma di gestione comunitaria, formazione considerata equivalente o volontà di intraprenderla.

• Confermata esperienza professionale in pediatria (minimo 3 anni).

• Esperienza di gestione del team come risorsa.

• Masterizzazione della lingua francese e buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca.

• Leadership federata, capacità di mobilitare le squadre e il cambiamento di supporto.

• Qualità relazionali eccellenti, senso di comunicazione, ascolto e negoziazione.

• Capacità di rete e favorire la collaborazione interprofessionale.

• Personalità attiva, dinamica, creativa e flessibile, dimostrando rigore e autonomia.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The HFR Paediatric Service is looking for a Head Nurse for Care Unit (ICUS) to join a dynamic and committed team. In this key function, you ensure the leadership and management of the care team, ensure the quality and safety of care and actively contribute to the development of the service. You will evolve in a stimulating interprofessional environment, where team support, innovation and continuous improvement are central.

• Anticipate, organize and manage the entire unit's health care staff, adapting resources to the needs and activity of the service.

• Lead, federate and support employees by fostering a caring, motivating and supportive work environment for professional development.

• Ensure the quality, safety and continuity of paediatric care, placing the child and his/her family at the centre of concern.

• Work closely with the medical profession and the various interdisciplinary partners, including paediatric emergencies and neonatology.

• Lead improvement and development projects, support changes, and contribute to service and department objectives.

• Promote interprofessional collaboration and ensure transparent and constructive communication with teams, the medical profession and the hierarchy.

• Participate in the general policy and organization of the HFR, embodying institutional values.

• Contribute, in collaboration with the Head of Service, to the annual budget process and to efficient resource management.

• Promote skills development and organize continuous training of staff in collaboration with the clinician.

• Diploma in nursing recognized by the Swiss Red Cross.

• Community management diploma, training deemed equivalent or willingness to undertake it.

• Confirmed professional experience in paediatrics (minimum 3 years).

• Team management experience as an asset.

• Mastery of the French language and good knowledge of the German language.

• Federated leadership, ability to mobilize teams and support change.

• Excellent relational qualities, sense of communication, listening and negotiation.

• A developed sense of organization, priorities and responsibilities.

• Ability to network and foster interprofessional collaboration.

• Proactive, dynamic, creative and flexible personality, demonstrating rigour and autonomy.

• framework, federate and develop the team: define clear objectives, support employees, evaluate results and ensure compliance with the framework

• changing practices and strengthening a culture of cooperation, accountability and patient guidance by valuing the skills and initiatives of employees

• pilot transport and logistics projects, from needs analysis to implementation, monitoring time, resources and results

• ensure the link between the different services of the hospital and the transport team

• develop collaboration with healthcare, medical, technical and logistical services in order to improve coordination and fluidity of transport

• analyse activity from relevant field observations and indicators, define improvement actions and measure their effects

• control and monitor and maintain transport equipment

• knowledge and enforcement of waste management, patient transport and safety rules

• participate and stimulate interdisciplinary work accompanying cultural change in the team

• collaborate in the development and management of the Procurement and Supply Department in accordance with the HFR Charter and Values

• vocational training in the field of logistics, transport, health or in a relevant field supplemented by management training, or route deemed equivalent

• certificate of transport of patients intramural or equivalent (possibility to acquire in-service)

• successful experience of at least 5 years in supervising an operational team; a hospital experience is an asset

• concrete experience in carrying out projects and implementing organizational changes, with demonstrable results

• unifying leadership and ability to set a clear framework, make decisions and ensure its application with fairness and consistency

• mastery of the French language with very good knowledge of the German language

• confirmed skills in communication, negotiation and conflict management; experience of dialogue with staff representatives or social partners is an asset

• ability to structure activities, manage priorities and use indicators to improve service quality and efficiency

• évaluer les patients adultes hospitalisés et ambulatoires (phases post-aiguë et chronique) présentant diverses pathologies neurologiques et neurochirurgicales (AVC, TCC, maladies auto-immunes, inflammatoires, neurodégénératives, etc.)

descriptionByLocale.en:

• evaluate adult in-patient and out-patient patients (post-acute and chronic phases) with various neurological and neurosurgical conditions (AVC, TCC, autoimmune, inflammatory, neurodegenerative, etc.)

• holder of a Master's degree in Psychology or equivalent

• professional experience of at least 3 years in adult clinical neuropsychology

• mastery of the French language with good knowledge of the German language

• Sociable personality, empathic, ability to work independently and as a team
